verdicts.rationale: REST v2 entities/search accepts groupByField='vector' (the vector field itself) without validation. Grouping by vector fields is semantically invalid - vectors are high-dimensional data points, not categorical values. Source code shows groupByField validation is missing (contrast with other search parameter validations). This matches REST v2 data handling bug pattern. Reproducible: search with groupParams.groupByField='vector' → HTTP 200 success, executes invalid grouping.
